grh_dfedadff593a63546cf8.title: We Hold These Truths
paragraphs: Rivers End's civic leaders ask Dr. Christian to secure glamorous celebrities for a large War Bond rally, believing famous names are needed to push the local drive over the top. Christian agrees to provide 'stars,' but at the rally he explains that a town should not need show-business glamour to understand either the duty or the practical value of buying bonds. His guests are instead four servicemen: Sergeant Claude Baker, Corporal Stanley Winisaki, Private Streather and Private Swenson. Christian interviews them about their homes, backgrounds, reasons for serving and hopes for the future. One comes from a prosperous Boston family, another is the son of Polish immigrants, and the four different lives converge on ordinary ambitions, family, education and the constitutional liberty they are defending. By presenting them as the most important stars in America, Christian turns the rally from entertainment into a reminder of what the war effort is for. The example carries back into his own office, where he and Judy arrange to set aside ten percent of the practice's receipts and payroll for regular War Bond purchases.

grh_dfd4d2b72e1a73aad8e4.title: Sari
paragraphs: A wandering young violinist arrives in a Hungarian village searching for both the ideal girl and the great violin of a retired gypsy musician. He falls for the musician's daughter and persuades her father to travel to Paris for a royal performance, but the old man discovers he can no longer play after years of retirement. The young violinist takes up the treasured instrument and instinctively revives the melody the older man had carried only in memory. Impressed, the king grants him a title, removing the social barrier between the musician and the village girl he loves.

paragraphs: Eleven-year-old Rink Larkin runs away after his outlaw father is killed by the sheriff, convinced the lawman murdered the only man who had ever been good to him. Britt follows, hoping to stop the boy before grief turns him into his father, and a confrontation with another armed fugitive forces Rink to hear what really happened.
